reviewer.role: Skeptical checker only; did not implement the mechanism and did not edit implementation or account files

source_review.java_factory_order_confirmed: PSystemBuilder registers SequenceDiagramFactory, ClassDiagramFactory, ActivityDiagramFactory, DescriptionDiagramFactory, StateDiagramFactory, ActivityDiagramFactory3 in that order, and PSystemCommandFactory rejects a candidate on the first unconsumed or failing command.
source_review.fixture_logic_search: No shipping reads of golden SVGs, test-diagrams, include_str! fixtures, checker labels, or label-specific branch names were found in the inspected classifier/dispatch files. Test-only fixture labels remain in unit tests.
source_review.unexplained_constants: No new parity-affecting numeric constant was found in the typed classifier itself; the observed failures come from grammar/factory ownership and dispatch ordering.

coverage: All SequenceOnlyCommand families were exercised: Participant, Lifecycle, MessageExtension, Grouping, Box, Divider, Delay, HorizontalSpace, Autonumber, Autoactivate, Return, Reference, Pagination, Footbox, Note and Anchor.
Shared variants exercised include bare newpage, hide/show footbox, compact hidefootbox/showfootbox, show unlinked, note on link, partition and triple-equals sync bars.
Rankdir axes include left-to-right, top-to-bottom, mixed case, repeated final spaces, doubled internal spaces, doubled NBSP, tabs, NBSP and U+2003 em space.
Non-command contexts include comments, TIM preprocessor output, named-note bodies and sequence-note bodies.
Later-factory axes include Class, Description/Deployment, Activity, State scoring and weak arrows.

findings.title: Rankdir whitespace is over-accepted by Rust and NBSP/tab execute as Java errors
java_provenance: Pattern2.java:57 expands %s to Java whitespace plus NBSP.
CommandRankDir.java:55-57 matches internal %s separators and final spaceOneOrMore.
CommandRankDir.java:63 converts only ASCII space to underscore before Rankdir.valueOf.
rust_provenance: crates/rustuml-parser/src/parse/mod.rs:502-509 uses Rust regex \s, which is Unicode whitespace.
crates/rustuml-parser/src/parse/mod.rs:698-701 marks these lines as real rankdir directives.
Later parsers such as class.rs:707-712 only consume exact ASCII-spelled direction lines, so dispatch can accept a command that Java errors on.

evidence.java: exit 200; stderr contains No enum constant Rankdir.LEFT\u00a0TO\u00a0RIGHT
exit 200; stderr contains No enum constant Rankdir.LEFT\tTO\tRIGHT

findings.conclusion: The account's whitespace invariant is incomplete: regex recognition is not sufficient because Java execution accepts only ASCII spaces in the captured direction string. Rust accepts NBSP, tabs and broader Unicode whitespace where Java rejects.

findings.title: Sequence-only classification rejects lines consumed by later Java factories
java_provenance: ActivityDiagramFactory.java:78 registers UBrexCommandRankDir before Activity commands.
ClassDiagramFactory registers rankdir, class links and ordinary note commands before later factories.
rust_provenance: sequence.rs:188-195 classifies note left/right forms without 'of' as SequenceOnlyCommand::Note.
sequence.rs:205-208 classifies a message with inline activation as SequenceOnlyCommand::MessageExtension.
parse/mod.rs:1283-1284 returns Unconsumable when a rankdir directive coexists with any sequence-only classifier hit.

evidence.rust: exit 1; no UML factory consumes this rank direction command combination

evidence.java: exit 0; SVG data-diagram-type CLASS with a note entity attached to the Maker/Sink dependency
evidence.rust: exit 1; no UML factory consumes this rank direction command combination

findings.conclusion: The typed classifier still treats some lines as Sequence-only even when the exact Java product finds a later consuming factory after rankdir eliminates Sequence.

findings.title: Activity continuation does not model Java's v1/v3 factory ordering
java_provenance: ActivityDiagramFactory.java:78 registers rankdir in the earlier legacy Activity factory.
ActivityDiagramFactory.java:80 registers the legacy partition opener.
ActivityDiagramFactory3.java:105-116 starts with common commands, swimlane, partition3 and arrows, but does not register rankdir before v3 activity syntax.
rust_provenance: sequence.rs:132-143 marks partition and triple-equals bars shared with later factories.
parse/mod.rs:759-780 scores v3 activity syntax and legacy sync bars as Activity.
activity.rs:14-26 collapses legacy/v3 parsing behind one Rust Activity subtype.

evidence.java: exit 200; syntax error assumed class at ===SyncPoint===
exit 200; syntax error assumed activity at :do it;

findings.conclusion: A command being Activity-shaped is not enough; Java has separate Activity factories with different rankdir and command coverage. Rust's unified Activity path accepts combinations Java rejects.

findings.title: note on link with rankdir selects Class in Java but State in Rust
java_provenance: ClassDiagramFactory registers rankdir and note-on-link support before StateDiagramFactory.
PSystemBuilder returns the first non-error factory.
rust_provenance: parse/mod.rs:747-758 scores note on link for State and UseCase.
The rankdir fallback and weak arrow scoring do not preserve the earlier Class factory for this shared command.
findings.conclusion: Later-factory scoring still overrides Java's earlier Class factory for a rankdir-compatible shared note/link combination.

attestation.reason: The frozen Rust product mismatches the exact Java oracle on 8 of 48 fresh perturbations. Under T14, any mismatch rejects this mechanism.
